proof_scope: Adversarial Tau project-DAG node sanity-check contract enforcement for reviewer JSON, artifact provenance, attempt binding, visual screenshot receipts, and topology bypasses.

claims.proves: The retained matrix runs 30 Tau project-DAG cases through run_project_dag_contract and checks that typed failure codes, artifact hashes, attempt ids, visual receipts, and reviewer/topology rules are enforced by machine-readable receipts.
claims.does_not_prove: Provider semantic quality, human aesthetic acceptance, deployment, or GOAL.md completion.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Tau project DAGs enforce typed node sanity checks and fail closed on prose-only, malformed, stale, unbound, mocked, visual-receipt, and topology-bypass evidence.
